stem: Ritu studies the diagonals of a rhombus.

options.text: The diagonals of a rhombus meet at $90^{\circ}$ and bisect each other.
The diagonals of a rhombus are always equal in length.
Each diagonal of a rhombus equals a side of the rhombus.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: In a rhombus the diagonals are perpendicular bisectors of each other. They need not be equal unless the rhombus is a square, and a diagonal need not equal a side.

teacher.key_rationale: Rhombus diagonals meet at 90° and bisect each other. Equal diagonals and diagonal-equals-side are square or surface confusions, not general rhombus facts.
